criteria.quote: Same height. One Mega weighs much more.
criteria.revision: Keep the immediate contrast, but add Lucario-specific stakes in the next line: “Same height. One Mega weighs much more—and Lucario can read thoughts and movements through aura.”

criteria.quote: Mega Lucario weighs 57.5 kilos. Mega Z weighs 49.4.
criteria.revision: After naming both forms, add a documented Lucario detail so the story is not only a measurement comparison: “Lucario is the Aura Pokémon; it can sense the auras of all things.”

criteria.quote: How can these two Mega Lucario forms match in height but not weight?
criteria.revision: Make the question deliberately unresolved rather than implying the script will explain it: “What can these matching heights—and different listed weights—actually tell us about Lucario?”

criteria.quote: The scale gap is much larger, despite their matching height.
criteria.revision: Replace the repeated comparison with a new layer from the research: “The numbers never explain the difference—but Lucario’s aura can detect living beings and their emotions from over half a mile away.”

criteria.quote: Mega Z is much lighter, even though it is not shorter.
criteria.revision: Use the documented psychological reveal as the turn: “The stranger part is not the scale—it’s that Lucario reads feelings with aura waves, finds out things it would rather not know, and gets stressed easily.”

criteria.quote: Both forms measure 1.3 meters, but their listed weights differ. / The scale gap is much larger, despite their matching height. / Mega Z is much lighter, even though it is not shorter.
criteria.revision: Collapse the three restatements into one measurement reveal, then make each following scene introduce a different documented fact: aura sensing, aura control, and stress from reading opponents’ feelings.

criteria.quote: The contrast is clean: both forms are 1.3 meters tall, but their official weights are 57.5 and 49.4 kilos.
criteria.revision: Do not claim the research explains the weight difference. End with an evidence-safe pivot: “The numbers give us a mismatch, not an explanation. But Lucario can read thoughts and movements through aura—and even control aura waves powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks.”

Make the split about interpretation rather than asking viewers to guess a preferred number: “Which tells you more about Lucario: its listed measurements, or the fact that it can read thoughts and control aura waves?”
